description: Drupal's Settings Tray library JavaScript code managing edit modes, UI interactions, and Ajax link preparations for the Settings Tray module.

methods.name: preventClick
methods.description: Prevents default click events except for contextual links during edit mode.

methods.name: closeToolbarTrays
methods.description: Closes any active toolbar tray before entering edit mode.

methods.name: getItemsToToggle
methods.description: Returns items that should be toggled during edit mode.

methods.name: setEditModeState
methods.description: Switches the edit mode state on or off, updating UI and event handlers accordingly.

methods.name: isInEditMode
methods.description: Checks if the settings tray is currently in edit mode.

methods.name: prepareAjaxLinks
methods.description: Prepares Ajax links to work with off-canvas and Settings Tray module.
